comments.content: The batched updates still use Promise.all over individual context.globalState.update calls, which are not truly batched at the VS Code API level (each still triggers a separate write). This is functionally equivalent to the previous serial awaits in terms of number of storage operations, just parallelized. The claim of '2 operations instead of 47' in the comment is misleading. Consider clarifying the comment, and note that parallel writes to globalState may have ordering/consistency implications depending on the VS Code memento implementation.

The extensive [PERF] console.log statements throughout getAllExtensionState, updateApiConfiguration, and the new batch helpers appear to be debugging instrumentation. These will run on every state read/write and pollute logs in production. Please remove them (or gate behind a debug flag) before merging.
These [PERF] timing/console.log statements are debug instrumentation and should be removed before merging into production.
The [PERF] console.log statements are debug instrumentation. Additionally, replacing the previous single .catch() with .then().catch() is fine, but please remove the perf logging before merging.
The success log message hardcodes '(was ~535ms, now should be <50ms)'. This is a speculative/debug comment that will appear in logs and shouldn't be shipped.
